title.narrative: Supporting Innovation in the Philippine Technical and Vocational Education and Training System Project

description.narrative: The project will support modernizing the Philippine technical and vocational education and training (TVET) system, so that it can respond effectively to an increasingly globalized, technology- and knowledge-driven market. It will improve the quality of skilling programs, upgrade training facilities and equipment, and build the capacity of trainers to impart the higher-level skills and competencies demanded by the job market. The project will help the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA), the Philippine TVET agency, to undertake institutional reforms and forge stronger engagement between public TVET institutions and industry, thereby enhancing the employability of Filipino youth and workers. It will also support the government's National Employment Recovery Strategy (NERS) to help the economy bounce back from the adverse effects of the coronavirus disease (COVID-19).

Output: The Philippines' skills development ecosystem modernized Indicator: Career counseling and placement services updated in line with industry needs and made more gender-responsive, socially inclusive, and culturally appropriate Progress/Status: The series of activities for the development of the Career Profiling Instrument (CPI), were initiated in the Item Writing Workshop conducted in October 20-22. The pre-testing of the test items that were developed was administered in November by NITESD and the consultants of INNOCHANGE.
Capability-Building Program on TVET Career Guidance Counseling was conducted last November 18-20, 2025 for 28 (with 85% are female) career guidance advocates/ focal persons from RTICs and completed for the remaining RTICs on 3-5 December 2025 with total participants of 12 (with 83% are female). The training aims to strengthen the knowledge, skills, and competencies of career guidance and counseling personnel in TTIs, while aligning guidance programs with TVET learners' needs and evolving i ndustry demands, particularly in the context of 4IR/SIR and sustainable development, to better bridge education and employment and support informed career choices and employability.
